text:
Ivy Park: poking the suppression preview in Alerting > SLOs. added a compact state that shows active suppressions inline. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/example/suppression-inline
Markus Lee: quick glance 1. Compact is handy but when multiple suppressions overlap the badges collide. they should stack with a +N overflow. also the hover preview currently clips on the right edge.
Priya Shah: accessibility: the suppression badges are currently colored gray/blue only. we should add an accessible label (e.g., "Suppressed until Apr 5, 14:00") and an icon so color isn't the only affordance. screen readers need the end time.
Ivy Park: agreed. thinking: badge text: "Muted · 2h" and aria-label: "Suppressed until 2026-04-05T14:00Z". that keeps the visible copy short.
Markus Lee: for overflow behaviour, show first two badges and a pill "+{n} more" that opens a popover listing active suppressions with details. popover should trap focus and be dismissible with Esc.
Priya Shah: keyboard note: make the +N pill a button (tabbable) and ensure badge buttons have at least 44px target. when popover opens, focus should be on the first suppression row; use aria-modal="true" for assistive tech.
UIBot: visual-lint: 1977001122  badge-contrast-warning: current muted text (#8A8F98 on white) ratio 3.2:1. Suggest darkening to #5B6168 for body text.
Ivy Park: thanks. also microcopy question: current hover header reads "Suppression details for service-x" 1 maybe shorten to "Suppression: service-x" to reduce vocalization length for screen readers.
Priya Shah: shorter is better; but ensure we include context in aria-label for the popover: "Suppression details. Muted by policy: nightly-deploys. Ends: Apr 5 14:00 UTC." so SR users get the full info.
Markus Lee: small performance nit: the preview fetch calls a /suppressions/preview endpoint on hover. on rapid mouse movements we fire a lot of requests. debounce to 200ms and cancel inflight requests when moving off.
Ivy Park: good catch. also ensure previews use cached responses for the same alert id to avoid repeated network hits during urgent scrolling.
Priya Shah: last a11y check: when a suppression is dismissed from the popover, announce via aria-live politeness polite: "Suppression removed" and return focus to the +N button. include an undo in a toast.
UIBot: ticket created: design/1977001122  "suppression-inline: overflow, a11y, preview debounce". ETA PR: 1977001190. https://tickets.internal/1977001122
Ivy Park: action items: Markus - implement +N popover and debounce; Priya - finalize aria copy and SR phrasing; I'll update figma tokens and swap text color. Will share updates later today. :rocket:
